caseName: Mancuso v. Commission of Investigation of the State of New York
caseNameFull: Mancuso v. Commission of Investigation of the State of New York
attorneys: Anthony J. Fernicola for appellant., Eliot H. Lumbard, Nathan Skolnik and Arnold M. Weiss for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the Appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
